name: Heidi L. Wickstrom
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Chicago, Illinois
about: Heidi L. Wickstrom is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2022 - 2027. She works at Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard, PC, located in Chicago, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff and Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Plaintiff to the surrounding community.
Heidi Wickstrom completed legal studies at Syracuse University College of Law and graduated with the class of 2007. Heidi Wickstrom passed the bar in 2008.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
